button.label: Track Selection
button.supertip: Remember the selected passage so its line numbers can be cited in the response document.

button.label: Next Passage
button.supertip: Jump to the next tracked passage.

button.label: Stop Tracking
button.supertip: Stop tracking the passage the cursor is in.

button.label: Insert Line Ref
button.supertip: Insert the line numbers of a tracked passage at the cursor.

button.label: Update Line Numbers
button.supertip: Refresh every line reference in all open documents.

button.label: Remove Tracking
button.supertip: Strip all Review Tracker bookmarks from this document, keeping the text.
